study.question: Can the incumbent temporal representation be computed once as shared sufficient count tables instead of repeatedly materializing branch-specific supported histories and unused counterfactuals, preserving its predictive function while reducing measured complete-unit cost?
study.hypothesis: Source observation: g1-r0024-run_zero performs five independent _transition_support calls per forward (transition, direct gap, timing, serial, disabled run); the transition branch also computes unused exchangeable identity Gram tables, and the disabled run branch scans lengths/compositions. Its host wall cost is 870.957 s, inference 28.813 s, p50/p95 34.773/36.397 ms per batch4096. A single complete-pair singleton chronology can supply the exact selected chronological transition, pooled gap, gap/endpoint-age and symmetric serial-gap readouts. Reusing that discrete representation, omitting unselected exchangeable alternatives and the identically zero run contribution, should preserve parameters, initialization, count values, feature transforms, addition order and gradients of active parameters while reducing cost. This is an execution mechanism hypothesis, not new predictive information or a globally novel architecture. Any accuracy changes are numerical/optimization effects until explained.

nearest_work.difference: The accessible inherited _GapTimingParentModel computes pooled gap counts directly but still separately sorts support for other branches. Extend exact selected-statistic execution to the entire temporal trunk; keep the lifted 4096-column head and all parameterization fixed. Prior direct_calibrated changed parameterization and AUC; that confound is deliberately avoided.

Exact frozen standalone ancestor, SHA256 edf3eeec4c93925847da35fb5fc7ba05d737dda040344365d9076a86fb6a409c. All existing class ASTs are retained, final class renamed _ExecutionParentModel; a final parameter-free subclass selects legacy or shared execution. No new label/history/identity input.

Archived primary arxiv v4 text SHA256 83fb9eeca31e2fa3c557b6f08b893ad0018cefb33da6e00952136b9ce17e607e, lines232-283: pooling bottleneck and target-aware weighted readout. The task DIN baseline is adapted and uses softmax, unlike the primary unnormalized activation. This change neither implements a new DIN nor reproduces author results; it computes the existing task-specific discrete summaries once.

Author README at commit2c6e76804281954a3c969010a31712cd5054aca9, text SHA256656c9e5eec79c9843e907a555ede2bf0a66a0db3515916af3d655080057c5a75, lines4-8 confirms category/brand/behavior only and no item. Publisher full paper inaccessible; no full mechanism verification or DMR reproduction claim.

inherited_components: Frozen data identity bd5ca20f6c2ca3e084ad11e12bf6200adbd293e060e1efb96dcb070f64ff81fa; full first-six-day natural-prevalence training, validation only, 3 epochs, batch4096, history_limit128, Adam/lr0.001, seed42.
All static embeddings, target-match group pooling/counts/histograms, independent moments, norm readout, identity/context/repeat/overlap residuals unchanged.

Exactly the chronological/product transition head, observed pooled direct/lifted gap head, joint timing head, symmetric serial head and zero run head of g1-r0024-run_zero; no parameters added, removed, reinitialized or reparameterized.

Support: positive category and brand, valid mask, remove ALL timestamp ties, sort oldest first, compact remaining events; adjacency may bridge excluded events. Gap boundaries <=60,<=3600,<=86400,>86400 s; endpoint-age boundaries >=3600,>=86400,>=604800 s.

Same log1p/count scale log129, raw-product order, gap lift, head invocation/addition order and training loss. Static snapshots have undocumented as-of dates; truncated128-event histories and hashed/coarse identities remain limitations.
study.proposed_difference: Replace repeated temporal extraction with one ephemeral per-forward shared representation (no stateful cache): selected transition raw N,C,B tables indexed by16x16 target-match/action cells; pooled gap N,C,B and pooled C*B/N; 4x4 gap-by-endpoint-age; 4x4 serial-gap. Compute only selected counterparts. Preserve parent head calls and logit addition order. The zero-run contribution is kept as a cheap bias-free zero-input head so zero gradients and optimizer-state behavior are preserved without executing run histograms. Both cells have identical classes/parameters/config except temporal_execution=shared or legacy. This is one composite execution replacement; this contrast cannot apportion savings among sort reuse, counterfactual pruning and disabled-run pruning.
predictions: On identical weights and batch, raw selected tables match the inherited implementations exactly for integer counts; product, transformed feature and logit differences max<=1e-6 (float32) are predeclared equivalence checks. Diagnostics cover first512 validation impressions, independent scalar oracle on first8 and edge cases; they are implementation evidence, not population performance evidence. Independent double-precision scalar-oracle fractional raw-product comparisons use tolerance2e-5; inherited integer-count comparisons still require exact equality. Tensor execution remains pending.

Trainable parameter count remains17254067, embedding17078688 and dense175379. No new RNG draws, trainable capacity, supervision, data passes or optimizer/loss changes. Same-seed trajectories should be very close; exact bitwise full-training equality is not promised.

Primary efficiency target: >=5% reduction in measured inference seconds on full validation including gathering, with AUC absolute difference<=0.0001 and Logloss absolute difference<=0.0001 versus freshly executed legacy control. Also report complete wall/train/allocated GPU seconds, peak memory, throughput, p50/p95; speed without the quality bound is inconclusive.

Raw/statistic equivalence should hold under history permutation, masked padding, empty support, length0/1/2, missing categories/brands, timestamp ties and exact boundary gaps. Target/action invariance is NOT expected for transition tables; support filtering remains unchanged.
falsifiers: Any selected raw-count mismatch, newly nonfinite output, logit discrepancy>1e-6 at identical weights, or source/RNG/parameter mismatch falsifies the asserted implementation equivalence; retain failed host receipt and repair only if charged budget permits.

Failure to reach5% measured inference reduction under the predeclared quality bounds fails this efficiency hypothesis at observed configuration; no claim of a quality-cost gain from source-level operation count alone.

AUC/Logloss drift outside bounds despite pointwise checks means numerical optimization, checkpoint selection or an overlooked difference remains unresolved. Do not interpret a higher AUC as evidence of new information.

Wall-time changes alone do not establish GPU efficiency; host timing/order/noise and repeated measurements must be reported. No equal-compute accuracy frontier is established by the matched-pass comparison.
alternative_explanations: Count extraction may be a small fraction of total embedding/data-gathering cost; _parent_forward still contains expensive inherited identity/overlap computations.

CUDA scheduling, scatter nondeterminism, allocator reuse, host contention or numerical kernels may change timing/training path. A fresh legacy cell controls source/config recipe; one seed does not estimate seed variance.

Observed prior nulls: run_observed0.630764 and composition0.630815 both below run_zero0.630889; action_gap_joint0.630851 beats its marginal0.630648 but remains below incumbent and costs936.824 vs906.076 s. These do not refute temporal mechanisms, nor justify another representation expansion without attribution reserve.

Earlier count-only0.613095 lost to history-rich candidates; chronological/product gap signals improved substantially around round17; compact parameterization in round20 changed scores. Retain those positive and unsuccessful trajectories rather than treating all compression as harmless.

All101 accessible trajectory entries are success; previous_runtime_error=null. No execution failures are newly observed. Missing local Torch/physical data is an interface limitation, distinct from scientific counterevidence.
Candidate-supplied diagnostics are not independently verified; scalar analogues do not establish actual Tensor/CUDA behavior. Hardware timing and float32 gradients remain host-only.

contrasts.intervention: shared_temporal: all selected temporal count tables from one inherited supported chronology; unused exchangeable and run-count alternatives not materialized.
contrasts.control: legacy_temporal: exact inherited forward with fresh identical scratch seed, parameter allocation and cheap wrapper; historical g1-r0024-run_zero is an additional anchor.
held_fixed: same source class AST and parameter order
same scorer/checkpoint selection and host latency units
remaining_confounds: one composite execution transformation does not isolate each saved kernel
float32 GPU ordering and wall noise
one fresh seed42 per cell unless later host reserve supports repetitions
diagnostics cost is charged separately in total trial wall and is not inference throughput
contrasts.decision_if_supported: Prefer shared executor only if host equivalence checks, quality bounds and measured speed pass; freeze source/config/checkpoint and pair legacy for any affordable validation repetitions. Describe evidence as local computational equivalence/efficiency, not improved predictive mechanism or global novelty.
contrasts.decision_if_not_supported: Retain incumbent as best supported model. Preserve failure or null record; next falsifiable question is whether temporal construction or unchanged identity/overlap dominates measured cost. No additional tuning or budget increase.

cost_plan.estimate_ref: g1-r0024-run_zero (870.957s wall,746.972s train,28.813s validation inference); g1-r0025-action_gap_joint936.824s; protocol full-unit estimate704.373s is optimistic for current trunk. Snapshot remaining4043.171s, per-trial hard cap1760.932s. Preparation and diagnostics are charged.
cost_plan.attribution_reserve: Register only2 cells. Estimate <=1000s each including diagnostics, reserve2000s total for paired candidate/control. Diagnostic inherited-vs-shared forward is bounded to512 and scalar oracle to8; no local training/installations. If live budget cannot fit both full units plus reserve, stop rather than submit inadmissible work.
cost_plan.assessment_reserve: Nominal2043.171s remains before charged preparation if both cells cost1000s; actual reserve is lower and belongs to the host ledger. Reserve the remainder for required equivalence diagnostics and any affordable paired validation repetition. A complete three-seed paired suite needs four more full calls(~3200-3500s),which does not fit,so it is explicitly omitted unless a later authorized ledger demonstrates otherwise; single-seed conclusions stay preliminary. Preparation is not free. Do not infer live remaining time from a static snapshot or increase the hard budget. This phase cannot set repetition seeds or request closed tests; no test feedback is authorized.
cost_plan.stop_rule: Only these2 variants; no screening, adaptive retries, extra configurations or test requests. Host enforces current ledger and cap; never increase limits. After outcomes freeze the comparison suite before any authorized validation repetitions, recording source/config/checkpoint hashes and commands; if useful admissible work no longer fits, stop without calling budget exhaustion scientific success.
